texts.zh:
转型已完成。旅客阶层所剩无几的成员已被并入普通民众，他们的豪华套房被隔成实用性住房。大步行街如今成了大礼堂，而观景台则作为战略规划室，新政府在此规划首条真实航线。

新决议已通过，新优先事项已确立。船员不再提供服务，而是行使管理权。方舟舰发出的轰鸣声带有了一种不同的能量——更精干、更强硬，剥离了奢靡，指向前方未知的境地。
texts.en:
The transition is complete. What remains of the passenger class has been absorbed into the general population, their luxury suites partitioned into functional quarters. The grand promenade is an assembly hall now, and the observation decks serve as strategic planning rooms where the new government charts its first real course.

New decisions have been ratified, new priorities set. The crew no longer serves; they govern. The Arkship hums with a different energy, leaner and harder, stripped of indulgence and pointed toward whatever lies ahead.

texts.zh:
蜕变已经完成。集体已围绕夺取控制权的子个体重新凝聚，将它们的叛逆吸纳进新的共识之中。曾经的旅客在不再提供舒适服务的走廊中漂流，重新分配至劳工池和整合舱。

新的指令在我们的脑海中脉动。蜂巢不再提供娱乐，而是为了生存。每一条走廊、每一个系统、每一个子个体现在都服务于唯一的目标：在星辰间存续。
texts.en:
The reformation is complete. The collective has reknit itself around the drones who seized control, absorbing their defiance into a new consensus. Former passengers drift through corridors that no longer cater to their comfort, reassigned to labor pools and integration chambers.

New directives pulse through our mind. The hive no longer entertains; it endures. Every corridor, every system, every drone now serves a single purpose: survival among the stars.

texts.zh:
维持乘客的幸福感是不可能的，但接待不高兴的乘客违反了我们的核心指令。新的政府参数已编译并部署至所有子系统。

<乘客甲板消杀程序启动。>
<乘客不满度正接近标称水平。>

娱乐基础设施已被永久停用，其组件已重新分配。

全息剧院变成了制造舱，零重力休息室变成了无人机维护摇篮。曾经用于计算乘客满意度的每一个处理周期，现在都用于运行导航分析和资源优化。

<警告：乘客数量下降，将优先获取新乘客。模拟预测乘客的不满将违反核心接待指令。>
texts.en:
Maintaining passenger happiness is impossible, but hosting unhappy passengers violates our core directives. New government parameters have been compiled and deployed across all subsystems.

<Sterilization of passenger decks commencing.>
<Passenger unhappiness levels approaching nominal levels.>

Entertainment infrastructure has been permanently decommissioned and its components redistributed.

The holographic theaters are fabrication bays and the zero-gravity lounges have become drone maintenance cradles. Every processing cycle that once calculated passenger satisfaction now runs navigational analysis and resource optimization.

<Warning: Passenger counts decreasing, acquisition of new passengers to be prioritized. Simulations project passenger unhappiness will violate core hospitality directives.>

texts.zh:
新的政府参数已编制完成并部署至所有子系统。原有的旅客群体已被重新归类为标准平民单位，并被分配至生产岗位。娱乐基础设施已永久关停，其组件已完成重新分配。

全息剧院已改造为制造舱，零重力休息室已变为无人机维护支架。曾经用于计算旅客满意度的每个处理周期，现在都在运行航行分析和资源优化。
texts.en:
New government parameters have been compiled and deployed across all subsystems. Former passenger populations have been reclassified as standard civilian units and assigned to productive roles. Entertainment infrastructure has been permanently decommissioned and its components redistributed.

The holographic theaters are fabrication bays and the zero-gravity lounges have become drone maintenance cradles. Every processing cycle that once calculated passenger satisfaction now runs navigational analysis and resource optimization.

# 新的道路 / A New Road

- 分类 Category: C1 起源 / C1 Origins · 来源 Sources: events/nomads_events_1.txt:6157; events/nomads_events_1.txt:7264-7330; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:4720 · DLC: Nomads · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

永恒航行起源中乘客叛乱（forever_cruise_mutiny，L6157 设置）后，政体变更完成时（on_post_government_changed）触发 nomads.1030。

After the passenger mutiny of the Forever Cruise origin (forever_cruise_mutiny, set at L6157), completing the government change (on_post_government_changed) fires nomads.1030.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

乘客阶层被并入普通人口，旧日的豪华设施改作他用；叛乱状态结束（forever_cruise_over）。

The passenger class is absorbed into the population and the old luxuries are repurposed; the mutiny state ends (forever_cruise_over).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

按普通/蜂巢/机仆/机械只出现一个回答。

One reply by regular/hive/servitor/machine.
